title: Templated Payload Object
description: One per slide (six per carousel), produced by the Payload Mapper. Maps a Carousel Content Object slide onto a template_id and its variable layers. Defined in DC-003-T002 §3. The mapper is not implemented as part of DC-003-I001 — this schema only describes the shape its output must have.

layers.description: Keyed by layer name (see config/templates.json 'variable' list for the slide_type). Each value is { "text": string }. Not enforced key-by-key here — the set of valid keys is per-template config, not schema.
